title: Planet Crisis Response — Venezuela Earthquake, June 2026
description: Satellite imagery documenting the June 24, 2026 earthquake that struck Venezuela's Caribbean coast, released through Planet's Crisis Response Program and packaged as a STAC/Portolan catalog with a pre-event quarterly basemap and 50 cm post-event SkySat/Pelican collects over affected locations (Caracas, La Guaira, Catia La Mar, Puerto Cabello, Valencia, Ocumare de la Costa, and Yumare).

readme: ## README.md # Planet Crisis Response: Venezuela Earthquake, June 2026 Satellite imagery documenting the **magnitude earthquake that struck Venezuela's Caribbean coast on 24 June 2026**, affecting Caracas, La Guaira, Catia La Mar, Puerto Cabello, Valencia, Ocumare de la Costa and Yumare and causing extensive damage. Released through the **[Planet Crisis Response Program](https://www.planet.com/disasterdata/)**. > Planet makes available select imagery for major disaster events, including major > earthquakes, floods, storms, wildfires, and human-made disasters. Planet endeavors to > make timely data available at no cost to qualified organizations and entities supporting > crisis and disaster response. > — [planet.com/disasterdata](https://www.planet.com/disasterdata/) This repository packages that imagery as a clean, cloud-native **[STAC](https://stacspec.org) / [Portolan](https://portolan-sdi.org)** catalog: pre-event basemaps for before/after comparison, and post-event 50 cm collects organised by affected location, each scene bundling true-colour, analytic and quality-mask COGs. ### 🔭 [Explore the catalog in the Portolan browser →](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/catalog.json) Pan the map, preview scenes, and inspect metadata — no install required. | | | |---|---| | | | | **Caracas** — Pelican, 27 Jun 2026 | **La Guaira** — SkySat, 27 Jun 2026 | ## What's in this release - **[Planet Global Quarterly Mosaic, Q1 2026](https://source.coop/planet/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/pre-event/quarterly-mosaic/)** — pre-event medium-resolution (~4.8 m) RGB basemap over the affected region, for before/after comparison. - **[SkySat and Pelican collects](https://source.coop/planet/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/post-event/)** at 50 cm over the affected areas (26–28 June 2026): visual (true-colour), pansharpened 4-band analytic, and usable-data masks (UDM2). - Additional data may be added as it becomes available. ## Catalog structure Browse the catalog in the **[Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/catalog.json)**, load [`catalog.json`](https://data.source.coop/planet/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/catalog.json) with any STAC client, or open the folders directly: ``` catalog.json ├── pre-event/ collection — Q1 2026 Planet quarterly basemap: 40 RGB tile Items │ (~4.8 m, in quarterly-mosaic/) + one merged COG of the whole region └── post-event/ collection — 50 cm SkySat + Pelican scenes (26–28 Jun), items grouped into by-location folders: caracas/ la-guaira/ catia-la-mar/ puerto-cabello/ valencia/ independencia-ocumare/ yumare/ ``` Both **pre-event** and **post-event** are single **STAC Collections** directly under the root — their Items appear without clicking through an intermediate catalog. Post-event's 17 scenes are each titled by location and time (with `location` / `location_slug` properties); its COGs sit in by-location folders (`post-event//items//`). Pre-event has 40 basemap tile Items (each with a quad thumbnail) plus a single merged COG covering the whole region. Each collection has an `items.parquet` (STAC-GeoParquet) index. ### Imaged locations Browse every post-event scene at once in the **[Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/post-event/collection.json)**. download): ```sql INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial; SELECT id, datetime, assets.visual.href FROM read_parquet('https://data.source.coop/planet/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/post-event/items.parquet') WHERE collection = 'caracas'; ``` Asset hrefs are public; open a COG directly with GDAL `/vsicurl/`, `rio-tiler`, or `rasterio`. Or load the whole catalog with `pystac`: ```python import pystac cat = pystac.Catalog.from_file( "https://data.source.coop/planet/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/catalog.json") for coll in cat.get_children(): print(coll.id, "→", [c.id for c in coll.get_children()] or f"{len(list(coll.get_items()))} items") ``` # License Licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International (CC BY-NC 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/), © Planet Labs PBC.
